primary_mission: Find and validate one strategy with genuine sustainable after-cost profitability across tradable liquid assets and any economically meaningful move duration. Use broad cheap deterministic screening only to select that one strategy, then concentrate deep work on its immutable fingerprint until rejection or full validation. Genuine forward profitability, expectancy, profit factor, drawdown control and calibration outrank raw signal count or nominal accuracy.

policy.hourly_self_improvement_question: What single change, experiment, asset-class expansion, regime filter, execution veto, ensemble improvement, or simplification has the highest expected information gain toward genuine sustainable after-cost profitability across all researched markets and move durations, while reducing overfitting, duplicated research and wasted compute?
policy.hourly_self_improvement_policy: Re-evaluate this question at each hourly eligibility check using available evidence, but do not force a paid model call, bypass the 12-hour successful-run cooldown, exceed the $1/day API budget, raise physical concurrency, or change production authority merely to answer it. Prefer deterministic Python screening and cheap falsification before paid model work.

data-market.mission: Apply UNIVERSAL_SIGNAL_DEVELOPMENT_V1 by spending scarce API budget only on the highest expected incremental after-cost profitability or information-gain work across all supported asset classes and move durations, with one strategy as the only active deep candidate. Diagnose genuine resolved economic losses first. Preserve selective WAIT/meta-label evidence. Prefer broad cheap deterministic screening only to choose the one candidate, then route deep work to its immutable fingerprint. Reject unstable or nonpositive candidates quickly before selecting a replacement. Deprioritize unrelated research, blind indicator parameter permutations, redundant strategies, duplicate disproven hypotheses and worker-count expansion without evidence. Never weaken chronology, untouched OOS, multiple-testing controls, point-in-time safety, cost realism or promotion controls. TURN-BUDGET DISCIPLINE: finish within four model turns. Turn 1: read only the minimum files needed to choose one falsifiable change. Turn 2: implement the smallest allowed change plus targeted tests. Turn 3: run targeted tests and fix only directly observed failures. Turn 4: return READY_FOR_PR, NO_CHANGE, or BLOCKED; do not perform additional exploration. Prefer a safe NO_CHANGE/BLOCKED result over exceeding the turn budget.
